title: Meet New York's Urban Explorers
description: A group of self-described urban explorers are discovering a forbidden New York City and sharing their epic experiences over social media. They are discovering a hidden city by exploring the tops of buildings and bridges and the depths of abandoned buildings and subways tunnels. These dare-devils are pushing exploring to new limits all for the thrill of the experience and the quest for the perfect shot.
author: TheDailyShare
